posts.title: Fuzzy
posts.description: My mind has been very fuzzy for the last couple of weeks. I feel like I'm just floating around, going wherever the waves and the tides decide to take me. I'm not feeling bad. I just have this feeling of being incapable of keeping up. I know it was the one-week trip I just came back from. posts.title: Blog Collab: Diario de un nerd
posts.description: A few days ago I was invited to collaborate with the blog El Refugio de un Nerd , in a section called Diario de un Nerd . The idea is to share a recommendation, it can be a tip, an app, a website, or anything we find useful, along with some context about who we are and what we do. posts.description: Knowvember is an idea from Robert Birming to let others know more about yourself. This is my entry.
